tagline: The coolest dog in Vice City is now on-chain. Turn the key and floor it.
aboutTitle: The dog is behind the wheel
aboutText: Dog Auto Theft VI is a community-driven meme coin inspired by the most anticipated game launch of the decade. No presale, no hidden wallets: the supply is open to everyone and the distribution is spelled out below.
roadSub: Four stops, one goal: be first to arrive in Vice City.

phases.title: Phase 1: The heist plan
items: Website and social accounts go live

steps.title: Set up a wallet
steps.text: Download a Solana wallet such as Phantom.

steps.title: Get SOL
steps.text: Buy SOL on an exchange and send it to your wallet.

steps.title: Connect to a DEX
steps.text: Open Jupiter or Raydium and connect your wallet.

steps.title: Swap for $DAT
steps.text: Paste the contract address and swap your SOL for $DAT.

disc1: $DAT is a meme coin. It is not investment advice and promises no returns. Only trade what you can afford to lose.
disc2: Dog Auto Theft VI is an independent community project and is not affiliated with any game company.
